V1/V2 compatibility matrix preserving STARTED/HEARTBEAT/YIELDED/SUBMITTED/STOPPED and ledger V4

patches.title: Single authority and identity policy snapshot
source_evidence: studio/v1/OPERATING_CONTRACT.md — owner-controlled merge policy and authenticated accountable heads
scripts/studio_comms.py:272-291 — shared-owner actor identity is not independent worker authentication
studio/architecture/hyperscale/v1/01_CONTRACTS_AND_SEMANTICS.md — v2 authorization is a proposal
patches.objective: Freeze policy revisions and require cryptographically separable actor, owner approval and shift/assignment epochs for any privileged transition.
contracts: PolicySnapshotV2 includes immutable approval ref, verifier, digest, scope, expiry, revocation generation
WorkerPrincipal, ExecutorAttempt, ShiftAuthorization, SourceLease and OwnerDecision typed schemas
Capability-matrix policy: observation, inbox read, source write, QA, merge, spending, oversight enforcement
Freeze exact principal/worker/chat_thread/execution_attempt/studio_shift identity hierarchy; UUID alone cannot authenticate a chat sharing an owner connector.
Owner-approved BASELINE_CHANGE_ID must explicitly resolve Drive BL-00/BL-08 queue authority before PostgreSQL can become the single runtime writer.
preserves: GitHub Issues/approved runtime are owner-policy authority; database caches only validated revisions
Independent review and exact SHA remain separate from successful CI
out_of_scope: No default privilege elevation from a model role, Issue label, shared owner token or signed-looking URL
verification: Unknown/stale/revoked policy revision or unverified issuer fails closed
Synthetic owner-forgery and role-spoof messages cannot become approval
Spoofed worker_id or role with unverified shared connector cannot perform protected action despite unique attempt_id.
completion_gate: Independent architecture approval freezes signed policy contract; every privileged adapter has executable negative tests

patches.title: Authenticated ingress and principal-bound event deduplication
source_evidence: scripts/studio_comms.py:336-352 — Issue comment scanner uses bounded per-Issue pages, no durable cursor
scripts/studio_comms.py:272-309 — actor login and worker_id are distinct trust strengths
patches.objective: Authenticate provider delivery and logical worker where supported, limit abuse, and preserve a recoverable cursor for missed events.
contracts: Webhook signature and installation identity verification; binding from principal->worker->assignment_epoch
Persistent source-event idempotency key and monotonic reconciliation cursor with overlap and gap alerts
Per-identity rate budget, rejection/quarantine and bounded payload/provenance normalization
preserves: Untrusted Issue comments remain archive-only without independent actor assertion
At-least-once input with no lost accepted event under retry
out_of_scope: No granting model credentials directly to ordinary prompts or private Oversight case reads
verification: Replay, wrong installation, stale credential, spoofed worker and duplicate deliveries rejected or recorded once
API rate limit, deleted comment, long Issue history and webhook outage recover without dropping accepted inputs
completion_gate: No privilege granted by unverified transport identity; missed-delivery replay and source lineage are tested

patches.title: Transactional accepted events and GitHub publication saga
source_evidence: studio/architecture/hyperscale/v1/00_ARCHITECTURE.md — transaction/outbox exists as target, not service
scripts/studio.py:359-385 — local receipts and GitHub updates are separate operations
scripts/studio_ci_evidence.py:190-204 — immutable CI receipt files are a separate publication boundary
patches.objective: Implement an accepted-event transaction with an outbox and a convergent reconcile protocol for commits, CI receipts, inbox state and job state across GitHub and the coordinator.
contracts: Per-job ordered sequence; accepted event insert plus outbox same database commit
PublicationSaga state machine: PREPARED -> COMMITTED_SOURCE -> VERIFIED_SOURCE -> RECONCILED_STUDIO or RETRY/QUARANTINED
External side-effect key = job+attempt+operation+source SHA; GitHub compare-and-swap and read-after-write
Dead-letter queue and monotonic durable cursor with idempotent replay

Design PostgreSQL normalized operational store: jobs, dependencies, approved policy cache, shifts, attempts, leases, events, outbox, inbox cursors, Drive document refs, exact-SHA evidence and usage budgets; single writer after approved cutover.
External Google Doc revision writes use a durable publication saga like source commits; verify document revision and export hash before marking accepted.
preserves: Source repo owns actual commits; GitHub owner approval remains authoritative
Queue broker remains at least once; never claim exactly-once execution
out_of_scope: No automatic force-push, branch rewrite or cross-repo distributed transaction
verification: Kill process between source commit and ledger recording, and after DB commit before queue publish
Double event replay creates one logical effect and no duplicate source patch
Orphan commit/receipt and GitHub outage reconcile using exact remote SHA
Shadow compare Drive live queue and GitHub job/approval state before signed SQL cutover; DB crash after Drive write and source commit recovers without duplication.
completion_gate: All acknowledged accepted IDs recover after crash; no duplicate protected side effects or fabricated VERIFIED state

patches.title: Backup, immutable archives, lifecycle retention and disaster recovery
source_evidence: studio/architecture/hyperscale/v1/04_DEPLOYMENT_AND_SECURITY.md — PITR/backup stated without measured restore gate
scripts/studio_inbox.py:23-40 — 100,000-event full-history hard ceiling
scripts/studio_worker_health.py:11-58 — health scan has a finite file ceiling
patches.objective: Remove unbounded filesystem scans and define tested restore, compaction, retention and independent integrity anchoring.
contracts: PITR and replica failure contract; owner-approved RPO/RTO by failure class before release
Immutable segment index, signed external anchor, periodic hash reconciliation and manifest reader
Retention/GC roots pin unresolved jobs, QA, external artifacts, legal hold and Oversight case separation
Restore procedure for DB, outbox, cursors, archived objects and authority snapshot
Back up approved Google Docs immutable export/digest plus revision map and Drive changes cursor; test restore and ownership continuity.
preserves: Accepted-event immutability; retained evidence remains discoverable by stable ID
No cold archive deletion that invalidates pending deliveries or audit manifests
out_of_scope: No custom consensus protocol or unreviewed active-active multi-region topology
verification: Restore from corrupted primary and lost object copy; replay overlapping queue delivery idempotently
Prove cutover restore with no missing acknowledged event IDs and no duplicate effects
Verify retention dry-run does not delete unresolved or held records
Restore with lost Doc change notifications still reconstructs accepted document graph by cursor and exact hash.
completion_gate: A timed, witnessed restore drill passes measured owner-approved RPO/RTO, integrity and privacy checks

patches.title: Deterministic load, concurrency and fault harness
source_evidence: scripts/studio_scale_probe.py — in-memory synthetic projection only, not transport or GitHub benchmark
tests/test_studio_v1_end_to_end.py — 100 synthetic workers does not prove live shift concurrency
patches.objective: Create a reproducible closed-loop simulator and fault injection harness that tests communication, lease, dispatch, source publication, deadlines and rate budgets.
contracts: Seeded 100/1,000/10,000 active attempts and 100,000 dormant identities with hot-job skew
Fault matrix: crash at transaction seams, DB outage, dropped ACK, GitHub 403/429, queue delay, stale worker, tampered artifact
Measured report P50/P95/P99, accepted IDs, duplicate protected effects, queue age, cost and recovery
preserves: No paid model calls, no unapproved source writes; test claims label synthetic distinctly
out_of_scope: No inference from synthetic results that 10,000 real ChatGPT chats are available
verification: Replay accepted IDs after every injected crash without loss or dual effects
Provider outage/shift STOP and resume sequence conserves budget and job authority
completion_gate: Reproducible seed+config+exact test SHA and signed result; real pilot follows independent review

patches.title: Assignment-epoch inbox and ACK semantics
source_evidence: scripts/studio_inbox.py:103-117 — current registry routing used for ACK validation
scripts/studio_inbox.py:34-70 — re-reads full archive for each projection
patches.objective: Make recipient delivery an immutable (event, recipient, assignment_epoch) record, with incremental replay and no stale ACK erasing new assignments.
contracts: Unique delivery key (event_id, recipient_worker_id, target_assignment_epoch)
ACK binds original delivery, currently authenticated recipient and original epoch, with consumer effect idempotency
Per-worker cursor, indexed projection, bounded page reads and deterministic rebuild
preserves: ACK means consumed, never QA or owner accepted
Reassignment never mutates historical source event
out_of_scope: No blanket fanout of lifecycle telemetry into inboxes
verification: Reassign between receipt and ACK; old ACK, forged recipient and duplicated event cannot clear current pending state
Replay from cold archive matches incremental current read model
completion_gate: Reassignment and 100k-event historical replay pass without unbounded O(all-events) steady-state work

patches.title: Verified project resume capsule and context reuse
source_evidence: studio/v1/PROMPT_KERNEL_V15.md — each attempt fetches job, registry, role manual, source revision and messages
studio/workforce/ENGINEERING_PIPELINE.md — compact context packet remains a manual reference
patches.objective: Minimize repeated cold starts with a portable, bounded project capsule built from verified source and ledger state, not from free-form worker memory.
contracts: ResumeCapsuleV1: job/worker/attempt ancestry, approved scope, repo/base SHA, latest verified checkpoint, ABI/revision refs, TODO/blocker DAG, valid inbox cursor, QA/CI state, expiry
Source-map/index cache keyed by repo SHA+toolchain+role, with source-delta retrieval and checksum verification
Atomic capsule publication tied to accepted attempt receipt; stale/rescinded authority invalidates cache
Cache Drive document_id + revisionId + section index + accepted export SHA256 and load only changed sections in worker resume capsule.
Use Google Docs requiredRevisionId write control and one accountable document owner per job to prevent silent conflicting prose edits.
preserves: Original Git SHA and ledger records remain the authority, capsule is a replaceable hint
Worker may request missing source when cache is insufficient
out_of_scope: No model-generated claim that an unverified capsule is itself source truth
verification: Corrupt/expired capsule rejected; changed source SHA and revoked scope trigger cold reconstruction
Measured context tokens/tool calls to start a job vs baseline; no skipped safety checks
Concurrent prose editors cause explicit revision conflict; changed Doc invalidates earlier editorial QA and cached capsule.
completion_gate: Capsule rebuild deterministically from immutable refs, and restart recovers last accepted work without context drift

patches.title: Actual shift executor adapters and admission/budget policy
source_evidence: studio/architecture/hyperscale/v1/07_SHIFT_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md — design only
scripts/studio.py:220-265 — ten S-slot allocator reserves jobs but never launches chats
patches.objective: Define supported execution hosts and a fenced, stop-aware session/shift scheduler, separating observations from real host launch/terminal receipts.
contracts: ExecutionHost interface reports capabilities: start/cancel/status, run_id, attested start/end, idempotency, supported credentials
Shift controller START/PAUSE/DRAIN/STOP with shift_epoch and auth, capacity by department and role
Admission transaction reserves estimated spend before launch, reconciles actual usage, denies overage and auto-stops on empty+reconciled jobs
Unknown/ordinary interactive chat is NEVER claimed as automatable; external Work/API invocation only with explicit owner budget
A unique execution_attempt_id is created per bounded response; optional chat_thread_id and host-run attestation remain distinct from stable worker_id and parent studio_shift_id.
Manual chats without attested host identity have UNVERIFIED_SHARED_OWNER status and cannot gain privileged rights from self-declared IDs.
preserves: Existing S00-S09 scheduled tasks remain separate from CW logical workers
STOP commands are authenticated and fenced; queue idle is not clean completion if QA/retry pending
out_of_scope: No fake infinite chat, unauthorized Work/API/model launches, or promises of guaranteed automatic restarts
verification: Lost host response, launch retry, delayed cancel, clock skew and STOP races do not create duplicate side effects
Reboot or host outage produces accurate INDETERMINATE and escalation
1,000 distinct synthetic attempts are unique and correctly grouped by parent Studio shift without granting source/QA/canon authority.
completion_gate: Verified supported executor integration with approved cost ceiling and no side effects for disabled auto_ai/source_writes

patches.title: Isolated source worktrees, writer leases and safe publishing
source_evidence: scripts/source_targets.py — fixed authorized repo routing and work_branch
scripts/studio.py:74-85 — naive path overlaps and S-slot writer limit; no independent runtime GitHub lease enforcement
patches.objective: Allow independent source changes only through isolated checkouts, signed leases and compare-and-swap publication that CI can actually enforce.
contracts: One isolated worktree per job/worker attempt with exact base SHA; owned path/resource classes with conflict detection for generated/ABI and wildcard paths
Fenced lease token bound to GitHub App identity, target branch and commit SHA; status check verifies before accepting PR/merge
Commit publication compares branch HEAD to observed base, retries by rebase only with revalidation; orphan worktrees cleaned after durable receipt
preserves: Source registry and original Terrain3D/gameplay architecture preserved
QA/CI at exact final SHA; no direct writes to protected default branch by workers
out_of_scope: No expanding live writer slots or rewriting shared branches in this design PR
verification: Stale lease, overlapping protected paths, branch HEAD moved and unknown GitHub actor fail closed
Process killed after commit but before receipt still produces one reconciled source patch
completion_gate: Two workers cannot publish conflicting protected paths or merge using stale QA/lease evidence

patches.title: CI artifact verification and supply-chain trust
source_evidence: scripts/studio_ci_evidence.py:175-185 — run metadata verified but artifacts_content_verified=False
.github/workflows/studio-*.yml — third-party Actions predominantly referenced by floating version tags
patches.objective: Attest exact built bytes, source SHA, toolchain and QA reviewer independence before accepting implementation; constrain third-party workflow execution.
contracts: Download and hash required CI artifacts; verify manifest digest, toolchain/inputs, commit SHA, run attempt, size/expiry and trust identity
Action dependency pinning policy to reviewed immutable commit SHA; least-privilege GitHub App, per-repo/scoped token permissions
Signed attestations and source diff/AST/SARIF compact review packet keyed by final commit
Verified published quest/dialogue records in NomadMain carry accepted Drive document ID, exact exported content digest, owner canon acceptance ID and source commit SHA.
preserves: Successful workflow metadata is distinct from passing independent QA or verified artifact bytes
Actual source repo CI remains owner of compile/test results
out_of_scope: No declaring binaries verified merely because an artifact index exists or signature is self-asserted
verification: Replace artifact bytes after metadata capture; invalid digest fails despite completed CI run
Rebuild at changed SHA invalidates preceding QA pass; compromised/revoked CI token cannot publish accepted verification
A mutated accepted Google Doc hash fails artifact review even if the URL is unchanged.
completion_gate: One full source->CI artifact hash->independent QA->owner/authorized head acceptance test at fixed SHA passes

patches.title: Oversight key isolation, owner approval readback and replay
source_evidence: TheNomad_Studio_Oversight/docs/ACCESS_AND_CONFIDENTIALITY.md — owner GitHub connector is not separate case confidentiality
TheNomad_Studio_Oversight/scripts/oversight_security.py:154-165,193-231 — signed notice checks owner_approval_ref URL format, not current owner approval evidence
TheNomad_Studio_Oversight/scripts/oversight_cases.py:68-92 — case envelope/receipt storage is local-only
patches.objective: Implement independently keyed confidential intake and deterministic signed enforcement, with actual owner authorization readback and immutable anti-replay state.
expected_touch_points: Oversight repo changes require separate reviewed source job
contracts: Independent encryption/decryption key custody with negative read-access test against production credentials
Verified notice ID, issuer key, approval object digest, owner approval epoch, target assignment and lease generation, expiry, replay table
External immutable encrypted case archive with restore/retention and minimal operational notice only
Protect distinct Oversight repository settings: restricted main/cases writers, private independent signing/encryption custody, external append-only anchors and negative access tests.
preserves: Production never receives plaintext report contents and allegations never self-trigger punishment
Lead Director controls invasive enforcement and key rotation
out_of_scope: No cloning private Oversight keys into Studio or shared worker prompts
verification: Forge plausible owner GitHub URL, replay valid notice, revoke signer, send mismatched job epoch; all denied
Unauthorized Studio credential cannot decrypt or list case material, including from logs and backups
Production worker GitHub App and general Studio Drive credentials cannot read Oversight cases or alter owner enforcement settings.
completion_gate: Independent security review confirms approval readback and case isolation before any real confidential intake

patches.title: Independent monitor, incident triggers and evidence-based productivity
source_evidence: scripts/studio_worker_health.py:41-140 — reads observed GitHub lifecycle, not independently verified process liveness
.github/workflows/studio-director-pulse.yml — hourly GitHub Action shares provider failure domain
studio/architecture/hyperscale/v1/08_HOURLY_REPORTING_METRICS.md — statistics are proposed
patches.objective: Detect silent auditor failure and stalled work without treating absent events as proof of inactivity; page owner only on actionable exception.
contracts: External heartbeat/canary freshness monitor independent of main Studio GitHub Actions trigger
Structured incident taxonomy: NO_EVENT, HOST_INDETERMINATE, CI_FAILED, AUTH_BLOCKED, QUEUE_LAG, REPORT_STALE, SOURCE_CONFLICT
Deduplicated email/alert receipts with source SHA and last verified time; worker durations must be host-attested or explicitly claimed
SLO dashboards and per-department throughput/cost, queue saturation, QA backlog and evidence lag
Auditor monitors Drive changes cursor freshness, document revision conflicts, SQL outbox lag, branch protection settings readback and GitHub permissions drift, with UNKNOWN if API access blocked.
preserves: Hourly email remains alert/report; it does not itself relaunch inactive chat
No confidential Oversight case metadata or private credentials in production alerts
out_of_scope: No claiming 100 real workers active merely because IDs are registered
verification: Disable Director workflow and GitHub API to verify independent monitor detects report freshness loss
Repeated alerts deduplicate per hour, recoveries send notice, leaked case metadata negative test
Missing GitHub ruleset readback or report freshness yields actionable alert, not invented enforced protection.
completion_gate: An external canary failure yields owner-visible alert without duplicating work or masking stale sources

verification: All existing 167 Studio and 23 Oversight snapshot tests plus new positive/negative integration tests pass
V1->V2 replay produces equivalent intended inboxes under stable authority, with documented corrections

patches.title: Shadow-to-live cutover, rollback and bounded real pilot
source_evidence: studio/architecture/hyperscale/v1/02_MIGRATION_AND_WORKGROUPS.md — cutover defined, not deployed
studio/architecture/hyperscale/v1/04_DEPLOYMENT_AND_SECURITY.md — cloud/App creds and recovery are unactivated
patches.objective: Establish a reversible adoption gate from synthetic trace to authorized real shifts; no deployment based solely on design validation.
expected_touch_points: existing V1 entrypoints only after owner review
contracts: One active projector/runner epoch; read-only shadow migration with source watermark and signed checkpoint
Owner-reviewed canary stage 2 -> 25 -> 100 active eligible workers and 1k+ simulated, expanding only on measured rates
Rollback/drain command with source-state reconciliation and consistent commit/QA/ledger receipts
Authorize owner-approved Drive BL-00/05/07/08/10 policy revision and one-writer cutover from Drive live queue to PostgreSQL; preserved frozen previous revision.
Protect Studio main/runtime/comms and Oversight main/cases with eligible private-repository settings before scaling privileged workers.
preserves: Existing Studio runtime source-write and spending restrictions until separately authorized
No auto-merges from unverified evidence or external token
out_of_scope: No extrapolating synthetic 10k IDs into real ChatGPT runtime entitlement
verification: Crash and rollback during cutover, in-flight CI/QA and source commit ambiguity; no lost accepted event
Real two-worker source->QA->handoff->email report validated with token and API budget
Queue dual-writer negative test, Drive revision conflict, protected-branch negative test and host-attested shift receipt all pass during canary.
